incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: OpenH3 opened, but the local OpenH3 Core backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart OpenH3.

incompleteInstallation.title: OpenH3 installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so OpenH3 Core cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest OpenH3. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined OpenH3 Core.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest OpenH3 package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined OpenH3 components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: OpenH3 package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This OpenH3 package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: OpenH3 opened, but OpenH3 Core stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling OpenH3 may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of OpenH3 is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of OpenH3, and this version can't open it. Update OpenH3 to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of OpenH3 newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update OpenH3 to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: OpenH3 opened, but OpenH3 Core stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling OpenH3 may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: OpenH3 opened, but OpenH3 Core could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart OpenH3.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: OpenH3 detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, OpenH3 will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Past conversations will no longer be shown, and the old database will be kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: OpenH3 is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another OpenH3 startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart OpenH3.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: OpenH3 Core is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: OpenH3 Core couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: OpenH3 Core didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: OpenH3 Core failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

rendererRecovery.title: Page error
rendererRecovery.description: This page could not be displayed. Reload to continue.
